Source: In this work, we perform Bayesian parameter inference using Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods on the Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) and Susceptible-Exposed-Infected-Recovered (SEIR) epidemiological models with time-varying spreading rates for South Africa.

Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ yìí, a ṣe òdiwọ̀n Bayesian inference nípa lílo ìlàna Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) lórí i àwòṣe Ìmúláradá - Àkọlù - Aláìlágbára (SIR) àti Àìláàbò-Ìmúláradá - Àkọlù - Aláìlágbára (SEIR) àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì ìtọpinpin ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àìsàn pẹ̀lú ìyàtọ àsìko ìtàkálẹ̀ fún South Africa.
Zulu: Kulo msebenzi, senza inkomba yepharamitha ye-Bayesian sisebenzisa izindlela ze-Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) ku-Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) kanye namamodeli we-Susceptible-Exposed-Infected-Recovered (SEIR) anezilinganiso ezishintshashintshayo zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: A cikin wannan aikin, mun aiwatar da ra’ayin ma'aunin Bayesian ta amfani da hanyoyin Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) a kan tsarin mai rauni-mai cuta-warkakke (SIR) da mai rauni-mai iya kamuwa-mai cuta-warkakke (SEIR) samfurin ilimin yaɗuwar cuta a lokuta mabambanta na yawan yaɗuwa a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Ka mošomong wo, re phethagatša kakanyo ya mellwane ya Bayesian ka tšhomišo ya mekgwa ya Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) go dimmotlolo tša ephidemiolotši tša Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) le Susceptible-Exposed-Infected-Recovered (SEIR) ka dikelo tša phatlalalo tša dinako tše di fapafapanego tša Afrika Borwa.
